Cavity Flow Predictor

Week 9 lid-driven cavity surrogate. The neural network was trained only on CFD for Re = 20–300. Here it is compared with new CFD references, including extrapolation up to Re = 1000.

Prediction error vs Reynolds number

RMSE of the neural network against the CFD reference at every 10 in Re (99 cases), computed in this page over all 2,500 cells. Shaded band: training range.

Model. The Week 9 network is unchanged: Tanh, 2 hidden layers × 32 nodes, 100 epochs, trained on 40 CFD cases with Re = 20–300. Nothing above Re = 300 was used for training. The browser evaluates its exported weights directly.

CFD references. Computed with the same class solver (50 × 50 staggered MAC grid, upwind convection, pressure projection) at Re = . Each case was accepted only when steady (max velocity change / Δt < 2e-5) and divergence-free (RMS < 1e-8). They are used for checking only. They are coarse-grid numerical references, not grid-independent benchmarks.

학습 범위 밖(Re > 300)에서 AI가 CFD와 얼마나 같거나 다르게 예측하는지 비교하는 페이지입니다. CFD와 AI 그림은 같은 물리량과 같은 컬러바 범위를 사용합니다.
